thread:
lucy (AP): Received credit memo CM-778 for -€5,500 from Vendor-EU referencing PO-2025-310 but original INV-601122 shows PO-2025-311. Auto-match failed (PO mismatch). Need guidance.
approvals-bot: Invoice/credit memo 2026-08-14-1865123456 queued. Auto-match error: PO mismatch.
vendor-eu: Hi Lucy, apologies. Our billing system split the original invoice across two POs; credit should apply to INV-601122 (PO-2025-311). CM mistakenly referenced PO-2025-310. We can reissue or provide written confirmation to allow manual apply.
jess (Billing): Can you attach the CM PDF and the original invoice excerpt? Need to see line-level allocations.
lucy (AP): attaching snippet:
```
Credit Memo: CM-778
Amount: -5,500.00 EUR
Reference: INV-601122-CM
PO: PO-2025-310 (erroneous)
Lines: credit for 10 compute credits @ 550/credit
```
martin (Procurement): Policy: credits must reference the same PO as original invoice. If vendor confirms CM applies to INV-601122 and PO-2025-311, procurement can approve exception if Finance signs off.
elain (typo?) (Finance Dir): (I should be Elaine)
elaine (Finance Dir): @martin @lucy Please send vendor attestation. NOTE: because amounts > threshold 5k EUR we need CFO sign-off for exceptions that change PO mapping.
vendor-eu: Attestation: "Vendor-EU confirms CM-778 should be applied to INV-601122 (PO-2025-311). Reference error on exported CM. No change in tax treatment."
lucy (AP): GL: 6102-Cloud-SaaS; project tag: infra-eu. Attached vendor attestation.
approvals-bot: Exception EXC-10111 created: "credit memo PO mismatch >5k EUR" routed to Elaine (Finance Dir) then Sam (CFO).
elain (typo?) (Finance Dir): Signed EXC-10111. Routing to Sam for CFO approval.
sam (CFO): Quick Q: Does applying this credit change any P&L for current quarter vs prior? Finance, confirm impact.
elaine (Finance Dir): It's a straightforward credit against operating expense; recognition already in the same quarter. No material change to revenue. Recommend approve to avoid vendor aging and incorrect AR.
sam (CFO): Approved. Please document in EXC-10111: "CFO signed to allow manual application of CM-778 to INV-601122 despite incorrect PO on CM. Vendor attestation retained."
jess (Billing): Applying credit now. Will tag invoice INV-601122 as reconciled and upload reconciliation CSV to the exception ticket.
lucy (AP): Applied -5,500. Ledger updated (EUR to USD conversion handled by AP system). Vendor asked if we still want a reissued CM with corrected PO for audit pack.
martin (Procurement): Yes, request reissued CM referencing PO-2025-311 and send copy when available. Procurement will close EXC-10111 once reissued CM is in the portal.
vendor-eu: Will reissue CM with correct PO and upload. Thanks for the quick handling.
ajess (Billing): Reconciliation uploaded. EXC-10111: closing when vendor file received. :white_check_mark:
